contract.label: Tooltip
contract.summary: A hover hint: a Provider shares timing, a Trigger reveals a portalled Content on hover/focus.

parts.name: Tooltip
parts.description: Root managing a single tooltip's open state.

parts.name: TooltipTrigger
parts.description: Element that shows the tooltip on hover or focus.

parts.name: TooltipContent
parts.description: Portalled, positioned popup with an arrow.

parts.name: TooltipProvider
parts.description: Shares the hover delay across tooltips (defaults to 200ms).

rules: Shrink-wraps to its content — never a `max-w` or fixed width that forces wrapping.
Portaled and viewport-aware; never pin a side that lets it run off-screen.
